title: Las 5 Celdas
description:
Las 5 Celdas is a short first-person psychological horror experience designed to be completed in one sitting.

There is no combat. No inventory. No way to win by force.

You wake up trapped inside a sequence of impossible cells. Each one represents a different human fear: loneliness, failure, guilt, suffering and death. To move forward, you will need to observe, interpret your surroundings and face situations that do not always have a perfect answer.

Each cell has its own rules, atmosphere and emotional focus. Some will make you feel watched. Others will make you feel powerless, guilty or unable to act.

Features:

- A short and intense psychological horror experience.

- First-person exploration with light puzzle elements.

- Dark, atmospheric environments.

- Disturbing sound design and unsettling situations.

- No combat, no inventory and no complex systems.

- Designed to be played in a single session.

This is not a game about fighting monsters.

It is a game about facing the things you cannot control.
description_short: Las 5 Celdas is a short first-person psychological horror experience. Explore five impossible cells, each based on a different human fear, and face disturbing situations where there may be no perfect answer.
